profile.legal_name: Lifestyle Homes LLC (construction licences held by LSH Construction LLC in Arizona and LSH NV Construction LLC in Nevada)
profile.org_note: Single-office, founder-run company with no regions or divisions. Lance Keller (Founder & Managing Member) leads; a six-person leadership team covers finance (VP of Finance, Controller), construction, project management and pre-development. There is no land acquisition function because the company builds on land owned by its developer clients.
profile.summary: NOT a conventional for-sale homebuilder. This is the Scottsdale, Arizona company at lifestylehomesaz.com (founded 2009 by Lance Keller), a fee-based general contractor that builds build-to-rent (single-family rental) communities for developers and investors; it is unrelated to the Lifestyle Homes companies in Florida, California and elsewhere. Every project on its site is in Arizona (it is also licensed in Nevada and says it serves Texas); a December 2025 trade article put it at about 25 communities and 4,800+ rental homes built, with 14 communities under construction. Its Builder 100 'closings' are rental homes delivered to clients, which explains the low revenue per home. It does not buy or hold lots, so it is not a direct land-banking customer; land decisions sit with its developer clients (Empire Group of Companies has 15 of the 24 projects on its list).
